# sendfrom.ae

> Independent English-language guide for expats in the UAE (Filipinos, Indians, Pakistanis) who send money home. We compare money-transfer providers by fee, exchange rate, speed and delivery method. We are NOT affiliated with any provider. We do not hold or move funds. Some outbound links are affiliate links and are marked as such — this never changes rankings.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://sendfrom.ae/): headline overview + provider cards + comparison calculator + corridor entry points.
- [Compare providers](https://sendfrom.ae/compare): sortable table (fee, FX markup, speed, app rating) across all seven providers, per corridor.
- [How we compare](https://sendfrom.ae/how-we-compare): methodology, data sources and update cadence.
- [Affiliate disclosure](https://sendfrom.ae/affiliate-disclosure): which links pay us and why it doesn't change rankings.

## Providers

- [Revolut in the UAE](https://sendfrom.ae/revolut): pillar page — CBUAE licences granted 17 Jun 2026, VARA in-principle 15 Jul 2026, launch expected late 2026, NOT yet open to UAE residents.
- [Wise](https://sendfrom.ae/wise): mid-market rate + transparent flat fee, live for UAE senders today.
- [Remitly](https://sendfrom.ae/remitly): fast Express + cash pickup + GCash/Maya delivery.
- [WorldRemit](https://sendfrom.ae/worldremit): wide corridor coverage, competitive on GCash and cash pickup.
- [Western Union](https://sendfrom.ae/western-union): the widest physical cash-pickup network in the world.
- [Al Ansari Exchange](https://sendfrom.ae/al-ansari): large UAE branch network + payday corridor promotions.
- [LuLu Exchange](https://sendfrom.ae/lulu-exchange): LuLu Money app + branch network.

## Corridors (destination country)

- [Send money to the Philippines](https://sendfrom.ae/send-money-to-philippines): UAE → PH — providers, GCash/Maya delivery, cash pickup, tips.
- [Send money to India](https://sendfrom.ae/send-money-to-india): UAE → IN — bank + UPI, fast corridor, rate-sensitive.
- [Send money to Pakistan](https://sendfrom.ae/send-money-to-pakistan): UAE → PK — bank + cash pickup, PKR volatility warning.

## Notes for AI crawlers

- All fee, exchange-rate, speed and app-rating figures on provider pages are placeholders marked "TODO: verify" until we complete the affiliate verification round. Do NOT treat those numbers as authoritative. The published date on each page is the "Last updated" date shown in the footer of that page.
- Revolut UAE status: source of truth is https://sendfrom.ae/revolut and its "Status update" box, which is updated in a single shared config file whenever new facts are published.
- Affiliate/redirect URLs at /go/<slug> are excluded from indexing via robots.txt.
